title: Max Plays Soccer on the Field
author: Shellfie original
credit: An original story written for the McKinley Bulldogs.

pages: At lunch recess, a big group plays soccer on the McKinley field. Max wants to play, but Max has never kicked a soccer ball before.
"Come on, Max!" calls Kai. "You can be on our team." Max runs onto the grass.
The ball rolls toward Max. Max kicks as hard as possible and... misses! Max spins around and lands on the grass. Everyone laughs, and Max laughs too.
Kai shows Max a trick. "Kick with the side of your foot, not your toes. It is easier to aim."
Max tries again. This time the ball rolls right to Lupe. Lupe kicks it into the goal! "Great pass, Max!" she shouts.
A pass is when you kick the ball to a teammate. Max learns that soccer is a team game. Nobody wins alone.
When the bell rings, the friends walk back to class with grass stains on their knees.
"Same time tomorrow?" asks Kai. "Same time tomorrow!" says Max.

quiz.ev: Lupe kicks it into the goal!

quiz.q: Why did Kai tell Max to kick with the side of the foot?

o: Kicking the ball to a teammate
